_meta.description: Seed customer cases for the Prospects view. Each case is a full engine input set. best/mid/bad/blank are ILLUSTRATIVE presets (not real customers); demo is the workbook demonstration case. best/mid/bad are derived from the illustrative fully-specified sensitivity baseline; blank is a prefilled starting template (common SG shared assumptions filled, customer-specific values left as honest blanks).

cases.name: Best case (illustrative, fully specified, gates pass)
cases.note: ILLUSTRATIVE confirmed-win demonstrator, NOT a real customer. A fully-specified, gate-passing scenario built from realistic Singapore-market figures: vehicle service/evidence 'Within entered limits', charging-site 'Complete' with an itemised depot quote, 'Within entered site limits', a numeric Total economic TCO and a positive Saving vs Keep ICE. The illustrative EV model is the SRM T3EV+ (nimble SRM variant, 11 kW AC / 55 kW DC, 53.58 kWh battery, 0.1786 kWh/km, catalogue base S$66,800). Its best EV plan is PLAN_B with a strong positive saving: Total economic TCO ~S$1,047,412, Saving ~29.52% vs Keep ICE ~S$1,486,117. This is what a confirmed win looks like once the charging-site quote and verification evidence are supplied, in contrast to the illustrative mid/bad/blank presets.

cases.name: Mid case (illustrative, marginal saving)
cases.note: ILLUSTRATIVE preset, NOT a real customer. The best-case SRM T3EV+ input set with the high-impact drivers tuned per docs/input-sensitivity-findings.md: EV purchase quote raised to S$234,000 (rank 1), commercial diesel price lowered to S$2.10/L (rank 4) and duty intensity trimmed (work km/day -10%, days/year -5%, ranks 6-7). All gates still pass; the best EV plan (PLAN_B) keeps a numeric Total economic TCO ~S$1,195,664 but the Saving narrows to ~+10.71% - still worth it, but marginal.

cases.note: ILLUSTRATIVE blank template, NOT a real customer. A clean slate for entering a fresh client on the fly: four truck rows across both sheets share one ID set (NEW-1..NEW-4) with the Include toggles on, but every gate-critical value is left blank/n.a.
